messages.subject: [Seqinr-forum] Server problems?
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I'm trying to run a modified version of a script to query Genbank for specific sequences from a list of species. The script appears to run OK but the query duration is very short and nothing is downloaded after using the getSequence command. I had previously managed to run the script with no problems. I haven't used the package in a while, I was wondering if something might have changed or if there might be a connection problem.

Thank you

Alejandro

messages.subject: [Seqinr-forum] Server problems?
messages.body_plain:
Dear Alejandro,

the access to databases  works fine now,

 > library("seqinr")
 > choosebank("genbank")
 > query("toto","sp=felis")
 > seq1<-sapply(toto$req[1:1],getSequence, as.string = TRUE)
 > seq1
[1] "gctgcccgcgcggtaactcctgccctgaggctcg"
 >


maybe the server  was very busy when you encouter problems in 
downloading sequences.

Can you try again and let me know the script  you are using   if  there 
is still a  problem.

All the best,

Simon
